application_type_full: Outline planning permission: Some matters reserved
description: Comprehensive redevelopment of land in Feltham town centre identifeid by the Council as Key Site M21 (bounded by the railway line, Bedfont Lane, High Street and Highfield Road/Homecourt residential area) to include the demolition of existing residential accommodation, car parks, a public house, library and some retail and office premises and the erection of a mixed use development with extensive public transport improvements, including a new pedestrian footbridge to Feltham Interchange, food superstore, shops (A1), banks and professional and financial services (A2), restaurants (A3), offices (B1), leisure centre,  library and residential (C3)  together with improvements to surrounding access routes and the construction of car parks, access roads, enhanced pedestrian links to the surrounding area and landscaping.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Approval of the details of the siting, design and external appearance of the building(s0, the means of access thereto and the landscaping of the site (hereafter called "the reserved matters") shall be obtained from the local planning authority in writing before any development is commenced.

Condition : 2 - Plans and particulars of the reserved matters referred to in condition 2 above, relating to the siting, design and external appearance of any buildings to be erected, the means of access to the site and the landscaping of the site, shall be submitted in writing to the local plannign authority and shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the buildings are occupied.

Condition : 4 - A scheme of phasing and timetable of development and timing of construction shall be submitted to and agreed by the Local Planning Authority before development commences and the development shall be implemented in accordance with that scheme unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place above existing ground level until detailed drawings of the proposed balconies and railings have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 7 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8.00am  to 6.00pm on Mondays to Friday and 8.30am to 1.00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - Before commencement of operations, a scheme shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority to cover the following matters:

(i)	any external illumination of the site

(ii)	measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site; and

(iii)	measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties.

The scheme so approved should be fully implemented.

Condition : 9 - No floospace exceeding 23,900 square metres shall be formed within the buildings hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal divisions without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 10 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 11 - The use of each restaurant unit shall not commence until details of the opening hours for each unit have been submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 12 - The use of each restaurant shall not commence until a scheme for the control of fumes and odours (and details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant) has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.  The scheme once approved shall be implemented before any restaurant may open for trade and must be permanently retained in full working order.

Condition : 13 - The use of each car park shall not commence until details of the location, type and appearance of all the directional signage in the car parks for pedestrians (including disabled) to the public and private lifts have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 14 - Before the development is commenced details of vehicular and cycle access to and within the car parks, including widths and gradients of the ramps; location, type and operation of barriers to and within the car park; circulation space; disabled parking spaces; lighting; CCTV and internal treatment of the car parks shall be submiited to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved scheme and permanently retained thereafter.

Condition : 15 - Before the developmetn is commenced, details of cycle access to, and details of cycle parkign in the car parks and the total number of cycle parking spaces for the whole development for the public and residents shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the spaces shown on any of the approved drawings shall be available for use before first occupation of any part of the development and permanently maintained and retained thereafter.

Condition : 16 - No development shall take place above existing ground level until the remaining details of cycle parking for the puiblic residents at ground level have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Plannign Authority and the spaces shown on any of the approved drawings shall be available for use before first occupation of the buildings and permanently maintained and retained thereafter.

Condition : 17 - Prior to any construction work on the development hereby approved commencing on site details of the arrangments for the construction traffic shall be agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority and shall include routes and access arrangmentsm, hours of deliveries, wheel cleansing facilities and waiting areas.

Condition : 18 - Unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local PLanning Authority no part of the development shall be occupied until the works for the improvement of the access arrangments at the following junctions have been approved and completed to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority:-

High Street/Bedfont Lane and Hanworth Road/Hounslow Road Junctions

High Street/Browells Lane/Highfield Road Junction

In accordance with a scheme to be submitted and approved by the Local Planning Authority before any part of the development is commenced.

Condition : 19 - No development shall take place until details of earthworks have been submitted ot and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  These details shall include the proposed grading and mounding of areas including the levels and contours to be formed, showing the relationship of proposed mounding to existing vegetation and the surrounding land form and a programme of such works.  teh earthworks shall be carried out in acordance with the approved details and the programme.

Condition : 20 - No development shall take place until the applicant has secured the implementation of a programme of archaeological work in accordance with a written scheme of investigation, (including the timetable for the investigation) which has been submitted by the applicant and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 21 - Construction of the car parks shall not commence until details for their ventilation (including details of sound attenuation for any necessary mechanical plants and the standard of dilution expected) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Plannign Authority.  the scheme once approved shall be implemented before the car parks are first used and permanently retained in full working order thereafter.

Condition : 22 - The construction of the foul and surface water drainage system shall be carried out in accordance with details submitted to and approved in writing by the Planning Authority before the development commences.

Condition : 23 - No development shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority a plan indicating the position, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected including all internal boundary treatments and railings to waterfront edges.  The boundary treatments shall be completed before any part of the development is first occupied or in accordance with a timetable to be agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.  The boundary treatments shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 24 - No development shall take place above existing ground level until full details of both hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

The hard landscape details shall include; proposed finished levels or contours; means of enclosure; vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas; hard surfacing materials; street furniture including seats, cycle racks, safety railings and refuse units; information/hisotry boards; lighting; details of design and appearance of each vent to the underground car parks.

The soft landscape details shall include; planting plans including full details of all proposed tree planting; written specifications including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment; schedules of plants noting species, which should incorporate appropriate native species alongside the watercourse; plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate; implementation programme including proposed times of planting.

Condition : 25 - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.  The works shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with the programme agreed with the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 26 - No development above existing ground level shall take place until a landscape management plan, including long term design objectives, management responsibilities, arrangements for implementation and maintenance schedules for all hard and soft landscape areas for a minimum of 5 years shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The landscape management and maintenance plan shall be carried out in accordance with the approved schedule.

Condition : 28 - In this condition "retained tree" means an existing tree which is to be retained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars; and paragraphs (a) and (b) below shall have effect until the expiration of (5 years?) from the date of the occupation of the development.

(a)	No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, without the written approval of the local planning authority.  Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard[3998 (Tree Work)] or any other BS replacing.

(b)	If any retained tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the local planning authority.

(c)	The erection of fencing for the protection of any retained tree shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved plans and particulars before any equipment, machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes of the development, and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery and surplus materials have been removed from the site.  Nothing shall be stored or placed in any area fenced in accordance with this condition and the ground levels within those areas shall not be altered, nor shall any excavation be made, without the written consent of the local planning authority.

Condition : 29 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.
Condition : 30 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall of the development hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 31 - Details of lux levels, direction and screening of any floodlighting shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before any of the buildings are occupied.   All lighting shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 32 - No development shall take place above existing ground levels on the site until details of the levels have been submitted to the Local PLanning Authority; and the development shall take place in accordance with those levels.

Condition : 33 - Before the development commences, a detailed site investigation shall be carried out to establish if the site is contaminated, to assess the degree and nature of the contamination present and to determine its potential for the pollution of the water environment.  the method and extent of the site investigation shall be agreed with the Plannign Authority prior to commencement of the work.  Details of appropriate mesures to prevent pollution of groundwater and surface water, including provisions for monitoring, shall then be submitted to and approved in writing by teh Plannign Authority before development commences.  The development shall then proceed in strict accordance withthe measures approved.

Condition : 34 - No development approved by this permission shall be commenced until a landfill gas risk assessment has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Where a risk from mitigating gas is identified, appropriate works to mitigate the effects of gas shall be incorporated in detailed plans to be approved by the Local Plannign Authority.

Condition : 35 - Prior to teh commencement of the development, further detailed to mitigate wind conditions where problems are identified shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 36 - The service area to the foodstore hereby approved shall not received any delivery vehicles between the hours of 23.00pm and 6.30am unless the service area is covered details of whcih shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  Any proposed variation tot eh above delivery time shall be first agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  All other service areas and collection points shall only be operational between 7.00am and 11.00pm. Monday to Friday.

Condition : 37 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the car parks, lifts, toilets, library, community facility, health centre, retaurant and all other commercial spaces, shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 38 - Notwithstanding the permission hereby granted, further details in respect of the density of the propsoed residential development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before development commences.

Condition : 39 - Before the development is commenced, details showing the position and layout of 200 car parking spaces within the curtilage of the site shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The 200 car parking spaces shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the approved scheme, for the duration of the construction of the development, to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 40 - The development hereby permitted shall not be implemented until all the legal interests in the land which benefits from this permission are bound by the provisions of an Agreement pursuant to Section 106 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 of an even date.

Condition : 41 - Before the developmetn commencies details of parking (including spaces for people with disabiliites) shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the spaces shown on the approved drawing shall be available for use before first occupation of any part of the development.
